body:
**requirement**
16.4.2 Verify that files obtained from untrusted sources are validated to be of expected type and scanned by antivirus scanners to prevent upload of known malicious content.

**recommendation**
from testing and writing report perspective I personally would like to see two separate problems written in two separate requirements (expected type and virus check separately)
title: V16.4.2 split requirement - expected type and virus check separately
